title: Strum exposes continuous shape and signed velocity tilt through the public MIDI kernel

needles: static std::int64_t shaped_step(StrumShape shape, double exponent
strum supports continuous shape exponents and signed velocity tilt

installed_sdk.rationale: The existing midi.strum-spread public binding now carries bounded shape_exponent and signed velocity_tilt fields in pulp::midi::StrumSpec; defaults preserve the prior quadratic shape and zero tilt.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No offline timeline command or node schema is added; the bounded kernel remains an SDK primitive consumed by an owning transform.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP request or response shape changes; the existing midi.strum-spread capability remains discoverable through the SDK manifest.

live_product_control.rationale: This packet adds no Product A operation, executor binding, grant, or profile policy.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: The existing midi.strum-spread design-time capability and public header binding remain the authoritative discovery surface; this row documents the newly bounded fields without creating a duplicate capability key.
